```{r define variables}
################DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS##################################
outputPath <- c("C:/Users/dand/Desktop/Desktop/GitHub/appliances_interventions")

short_summ    <- c("appliance",
                   "intervention",
                   "continent",
                   "statistical_technique",
                   "study_design",
                   "incentive_follow_through",
                   "experimental_setting",
                   "participant_type"
                   )

sumVarsCatego <- c(
  "aware_of_study",
  "opt_in",
  "randomisation_dummy",
  "outOfSampleBias",
  "reportingBiases",
  "year_publication",
  "year_data_study",
  "controls_energy_prices",
  "controls_environmental_attitudes",
  "controls_demographics")

# for these factor variables we want normal summary stats
sumVarsFactor <- c(#"study_ID",
                   "appliance",
                   "intervention",
                   "continent",
                   "statistical_technique",
                   "study_design",
                   "incentive_follow_through",
                   "experimental_setting",
                   "participant_type",
                   "aware_of_study",
                   "opt_in",
                   "randomisation_dummy",
                   "outOfSampleBias",
                   "reportingBiases",
                   "controls_energy_prices",
                   "controls_environmental_attitudes",
                   "controls_demographics"
  )

# for these numeric variables we want normal summary stats
sumvarsNum <- c("year_publication",
                "year_data_study",
                "percent_change",
                "total_sample_size",
                "z_value",
                "z_variance")

# for study ID we only want to see the count of unique values
sumVars <- c(short_summ,sumVarsCatego, sumvarsNum)

appliances[sumVarsFactor] <- lapply(appliances[sumVarsFactor], factor)
appliances[sumvarsNum] <- lapply(appliances[sumvarsNum], as.numeric)
```

```{r define data subset}
# dfinc <- appliances
# exclude outliers
appliances <- appliances %>%
  filter(!(study_ID %in% c('117','122')))
data_purchase <- data.frame()
# filter to a needed dependent variable
data_purchase <- appliances %>%
  filter(dep_variable_purchase_category %in% c("purschase (probability) of efficient appliance", "WTP for efficient appliance"))

dfinc <- data_purchase
```

```{r summary stats}

# for(col in names(select(dfinc,all_of(sumVarsFactor)))) {
#   freq_table <- freq(dfinc[[col]], style = "rmarkdown", cumul=FALSE, report.nas = FALSE)
#   print(freq_table)
# }
# 
# freq(select(dfinc, all_of(sumvarsNum)), cumul = FALSE)

# change output file name based on the data
dfinc %>% group_by() %>%
  select(all_of(sumVars)) %>% 
  dfSummary(graph.col = T, style = "grid", na.col = FALSE) %>%
  print(file = "summarystatistics_purchase.html")
rmarkdown::render("summarystatistics_purchase.html", output_file = "summarystatistics_purchase.doc")

# change output file name based on the data
appliances %>% group_by() %>%
  select(all_of(sumVars)) %>% 
  dfSummary(graph.col = T, style = "grid", na.col = FALSE) %>%
  print(file = "summarystatistics_all.html")
rmarkdown::render("summarystatistics_all.html", output_file = "summarystatistics_all.doc")
```
